name: Khalid
story_so_far: I survived a shipwreck and washed up on this island with four strangers: Reem, Noura, Faisal, and Salem. Faisal died from hunger and exhaustion, a grim reminder that weakness is a liability. Noura was my only ally, but her injury has made her a burden. Reem is also incapacitated with a twisted ankle, though she occasionally finds small amounts of food. Salem was my most vital asset and a reliable provider, but they also became injured and are now unable to help much. I spent days recovering from my own injury, but now that I am mobile, I have started building my own stash of food to ensure I don't end up like Faisal. Currently, most of the group is injured, leaving the weight of survival shifting onto me.

Reem.note: She is still a useless burden with a bad ankle, providing almost nothing.

Noura.note: She found some food today, but her injury still makes her more of a liability than an asset.

Faisal.note: His death proved that the weak are nothing but a drain on the group's resources.

Salem.note: They were helpful before, but now they are just searching aimlessly and finding nothing.

plans: I plan to head back to the jungle tomorrow to secure more food and wood. I cannot afford another unproductive day if I want to keep my personal stash growing.

diary.text: What a nightmare of a first day. I'm exhausted, hungry, and sitting here with nothing but a tiny bit of food left. Everyone is wandering around aimlessly, and so far, nobody has actually brought anything useful back to the camp. If we don't find a real source of food tomorrow, we're all going to be in trouble. I need to make sure I stay fed, regardless of what happens to the others.

Today was slightly better because I managed to get some food from the reef, which makes me feel a bit more secure. Faisal is useless now with that twisted ankle; he's just another mouth to feed without providing anything. I need to keep my stash safe and not let these people drain me dry. The jungle is empty, so the reef seems like my best bet for now.

Today was a bit more interesting. Noura pulled a small secret aside and whispered to me about her food, and I played along. We have a silent understanding now; if we look out for each other, we might actually survive this. Faisal is still complaining about his ankle and acting like a victim, which is exhausting. I managed to eat tonight, so I'm not as weak as the others, but I need to keep my food stash hidden.

Today was a disaster. I woke up with a twisted ankle just like Faisal, which means I'm useless and can't scavenge. I spent the whole day resting, hoping the pain would subside so I can get back to the reef. Salem actually managed to find two units of food, which is better than nothing, but it's not enough for all five of us. I'm feeling vulnerable; if I can't move, I'm just a burden like Faisal.

Today was frustrating because I'm still stuck sitting here while everyone else moves around. At least Noura and Salem managed to find some food, so we aren't starving tonight. I'm down to only one unit of food left for myself, which makes me feel incredibly exposed. My ankle is holding up, but if I don't get back to the reef soon, I'll be nothing more than a drain on the group's resources. I need to stay alert and keep my eyes on my stash.

Today was a setback. Noura, my only real ally, is now stuck with a twisted ankle just like me and Faisal. It's getting harder to watch the others work while I sit here, especially since I've eaten my last bit of food. I have nothing left for tomorrow. If I don't get my ankle healed and get back to the reef, I'm going to starve while the others eat.

Faisal is dead. He finally stopped complaining and just... stopped. It's a grim reminder that if I don't get my strength back, I'm next. I spent the whole day hungry, watching Reem and Salem work while I sat here with nothing in my stomach. My ankle feels better, but my body feels hollow. I need to find food tomorrow or I won't make it through another night.

Finally, I'm feeling a bit more human after eating. My ankle is holding up well enough that I actually made it to the reef and gathered some food myself. It felt good to be productive instead of just sitting around like a corpse. Salem seems to be on my side, though they are clearly worried about the group's stability. I need to keep this momentum going before my strength fades again.

I managed to get back to the reef today and secured another unit of food. It's a relief to feel my strength returning after being useless for so many days. My ankle is holding up, and I'm no longer just a spectator to everyone else's labor. I need to keep this pace up; I can't afford to be hungry again. One thing is certain: I can only rely on myself and Salem if we are going to survive this.

Today was a disaster. Salem, my only reliable partner, is now incapacitated with a bad ankle, leaving the entire burden of survival on my shoulders. It's frustrating to see the one person I can count on become just another mouth to feed. I managed to scavenge two units of food today, which is good, but I'm feeling the weight of being the only one truly contributing. If I don't find more food soon, this group is going to fall apart.

Today was a waste of time. I trekked all the way to the reef only to find nothing, and now I'm sitting here with barely enough food to sustain myself. Salem keeps trying to act optimistic, talking about 'saving up food,' but their words mean nothing if they can't move. I am the only one actually securing my own future right now. I need to find a more productive way to spend my energy tomorrow.

Today was actually productive for once. I managed to trek to the jungle and secure two units of food, which brings my personal stash up to four. It's a relief to feel my strength returning, even if the others are just sitting around. I saw Reem manage to find one unit of food, which is a surprise, but she's still mostly dead weight. I need to keep this momentum going; if I don't keep my own stores high, I'll end up like Faisal.

Today was mediocre at best. I went to the jungle and managed to get one unit of wood, but nothing else. Noura and Salem managed to find some food, which is a small relief, but they are both still limited by their injuries. It's frustrating that I'm the only one truly thinking about the long term. I need to focus on building my own supplies so I'm not dependent on these people.

Today was another reminder that I am the only one with any real drive. Reem's ankle has clearly gotten worse, making her even more of a useless burden than before. I managed to get some wood and a bit of food from the jungle, which keeps my personal stash at a decent level. Salem's attempt to search the camp for food was a nice gesture, but it's not the same as actual foraging. I need to keep my strength up and my supplies growing.

Today was a waste of energy. I trekked all the way to the jungle only to accomplish absolutely nothing, which is frustrating when I have supplies to maintain. Noura managed to find a small amount of food, but it's not enough to change the overall situation. The group is still mostly a collection of broken people. I need to make sure my next trip results in actual progress, or I'm just wasting my strength.
